events.title: Department of Labor rescinds coordinated enforcement regulations for migrant farmworker protections

events.title: NYPD officer shoots man on Brooklyn Bridge cables during mental health crisis
events.summary: A man climbed onto the Brooklyn Bridge cables early Friday morning, prompting a 911 call at 3:28am. NYPD Emergency Service Unit officers responded and spent approximately one hour attempting de-escalation, verbally engaging the man who was holding a knife and expressing suicidal ideation. After the man descended rapidly toward officers and raised the knife within 3 feet of an officer, an ESU officer on the roadbed discharged his weapon once, striking the man fatally. The man was transported to a hospital and pronounced dead. A knife and flashlight were recovered; body camera footage captured the incident.
events.why_relevant: A fatal police shooting during a mental health crisis raises questions about de-escalation protocols, use-of-force standards, and the adequacy of crisis intervention training in high-risk situations.
